title: CPU Image Captioning · Service and Host Monitoring
description: DA3408 A4. PromQL in this dashboard was generated with AI; every non-trivial query starts with a '# AI prompt:' comment giving the prompt used. Session prompt: "please complete the grafana setup".

list.name: Bulk ZIP job running
list.textFormat: A ZIP upload is being captioned

options.content:
### CPU image-captioning service · production monitoring
Read top to bottom: **health → traffic → latency → app-vs-host correlation → host resources → model & inputs**. Grey shaded bands = a bulk ZIP job was running. Colours are colour-blind safe and every series in a chart also differs by line style (solid / dashed / dotted), so the dashboard still reads in grayscale print. Every chart states its unit and axis scale; hover the ⓘ icon for the story behind a panel.

panels.title: 1 · Service health — is everything up and serving?
Caption app
panels.description: Prometheus scrape status of the Streamlit app's /metrics endpoint (up metric). ▲ UP = scraped in the last 5s.

targets.expr: up{job="caption_app"}

panels.title: node_exporter
panels.description: Scrape status of node_exporter, the source of every host CPU / RAM / disk metric.

targets.expr: up{job="node"}

panels.title: Captioning model
panels.description: Whether the default model is held in memory (caption_model_loaded gauge).

targets.expr: max(caption_model_loaded{model="blip-base"})

panels.title: App uptime
panels.description: Time since the app process started (now − process_start_time_seconds).

targets.expr:
# AI prompt: "seconds since the caption app process started"
time() - process_start_time_seconds{job="caption_app"}

panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description: Browser sessions that interacted with the app in the last 5 minutes (gauge).

targets.expr: caption_active_sessions

panels.title: Requests in flight
panels.description: Single or bulk requests currently being processed (sum of caption_active_requests gauge).

targets.expr:
# AI prompt: "total caption requests currently in progress across modes"
sum(caption_active_requests)

panels.title: Images captioned
panels.description: Successful captions in the selected time range (increase of the images counter).

targets.expr:
# AI prompt: "number of images successfully captioned during the dashboard time range"
sum(increase(caption_images_processed_total{status="success"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Image error ratio
panels.description: Share of images that failed to decode or caption in the selected range. Green ≤ 5 %, amber ≤ 25 %, red above.

targets.expr:
# AI prompt: "fraction of images that failed during the dashboard time range"
sum(increase(caption_images_processed_total{status="failed"}[$__range])) / sum(increase(caption_images_processed_total[$__range]))

panels.title: 2 · Traffic — how much work is the service doing?
Throughput · images captioned per second, by mode
panels.description: Rate of images successfully captioned. Bulk jobs show as a sustained plateau, single uploads as short spikes. Failures are counted in the health row and the Errors panel. X-axis: wall-clock time (local, linear).

targets.expr:
# AI prompt: "images captioned successfully per second, split by mode"
sum by (mode) (rate(caption_images_processed_total{status="success"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Requests · submitted per minute, by mode
panels.description: How often users click Generate (single) or Caption all (bulk). One bulk request can carry hundreds of images. X-axis: wall-clock time (local, linear).

targets.expr:
# AI prompt: "caption requests per minute over a 1m window, split by mode, using the _count series of the caption_request_seconds summary"
sum by (mode) (rate(caption_request_seconds_count[1m])) * 60

panels.title: Work in flight · running and waiting
panels.description: Requests being processed, ZIP images accepted but not yet captioned, and images queued for the shared CPU lock. A growing backlog means demand exceeds CPU capacity. X-axis: wall-clock time (local, linear).

targets.expr:
# AI prompt: "total caption requests currently in progress"
sum(caption_active_requests)
caption_bulk_images_pending
caption_inference_queue_length

panels.title: 3 · Latency — how long does each image and request take?
Inference latency · p50 / p95 / p99 per image
panels.description: Percentiles of per-image model time from the caption_inference_seconds histogram (all modes). A gap between p50 and p99 means occasional slow images. X-axis: wall-clock time (local, linear).

targets.expr:
# AI prompt: "median per-image inference time over 1m from the caption_inference_seconds histogram, all modes combined"
histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(caption_inference_seconds_bucket[1m])))

# AI prompt: "95th percentile per-image inference time over 1m from the histogram, all modes combined"
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(caption_inference_seconds_bucket[1m])))

# AI prompt: "99th percentile per-image inference time over 1m from the histogram, all modes combined"
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(caption_inference_seconds_bucket[1m])))

panels.title: Inference latency p95 · single vs bulk
panels.description: Same histogram split by mode (recording rule job:caption_inference_seconds:p95). Bulk images queue behind each other, so their p95 can rise when users overlap. X-axis: wall-clock time (local, linear).

targets.expr: job:caption_inference_seconds:p95

panels.title: Request time · average end-to-end, from the Summary
panels.description: Average time per request = rate(_sum) ÷ rate(_count) of the caption_request_seconds Summary. Single ≈ one image; bulk = a whole ZIP job, hence the log scale. X-axis: wall-clock time (local, linear).

targets.expr:
# AI prompt: "average end-to-end request time over 1m from the _sum and _count series of the caption_request_seconds summary, by mode"
sum by (mode) (rate(caption_request_seconds_sum[1m])) / sum by (mode) (rate(caption_request_seconds_count[1m]))

panels.title: Inference latency distribution · images per histogram bucket
panels.description: Each column is a 5s slice; each cell counts images whose inference time fell in that bucket. Darker blue = more images. A band that moves up during a bulk job shows the CPU slowing down. X-axis: wall-clock time (local, linear).

targets.expr:
# AI prompt: "images per inference-time bucket in each interval, from the caption_inference_seconds histogram, formatted for a heatmap"
sum by (le) (increase(caption_inference_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Pipeline stages p95 · preprocessing vs waiting for the CPU
panels.description: Time spent before the model runs: decoding/resizing the image, and waiting for the shared inference lock. Waiting time rises when several users caption at once. X-axis: wall-clock time (local, linear).

targets.expr:
# AI prompt: "95th percentile image preprocessing time over 1m from the caption_preprocess_seconds histogram"
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(caption_preprocess_seconds_bucket[1m])))

# AI prompt: "95th percentile time spent waiting for the inference lock over 1m from the caption_queue_wait_seconds histogram"
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(caption_queue_wait_seconds_bucket[1m])))

panels.title: 4 · Correlation — does app load explain host load?
CPU · host utilisation vs the caption app's share
panels.description: Both lines use the same 0–100 % axis of total host CPU. When a bulk job runs, the dashed app line rises and the host line follows it; the gap between them is everything else on the machine. X-axis: wall-clock time (local, linear).

targets.expr: instance:node_cpu_utilisation:ratio
job:caption_process_cpu_share_of_host:ratio

panels.title: Memory · host utilisation vs the caption app's share
panels.description: Share of total RAM in use on the host and the share held by the app process (model weights + images in flight). A flat app line during bulk jobs shows images are streamed, not buffered. X-axis: wall-clock time (local, linear).

targets.expr: instance:node_memory_utilisation:ratio
job:caption_process_memory_share_of_host:ratio

panels.title: Workload · images captioned per second (all modes)
panels.description: The application-side driver of the CPU chart above, on the same time axis. Read the two panels together: plateaus here should line up with CPU plateaus above. X-axis: wall-clock time (local, linear).

targets.expr:
# AI prompt: "total images processed per second across modes and statuses"
sum(rate(caption_images_processed_total[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: App memory · resident set vs model weights
panels.description: Bytes held by the app process (RSS) compared with the bytes of the loaded model's parameters. The difference is Python, torch and per-request buffers. X-axis: wall-clock time (local, linear).

targets.expr: process_resident_memory_bytes{job="caption_app"}

# AI prompt: "total memory used by loaded model weights across models"
sum(caption_model_memory_bytes)

panels.title: 5 · Host resources (node_exporter) — where is the machine under pressure?
CPU by mode · stacked share of all cores
panels.description: Breakdown of busy CPU time. Model inference shows up as user time (or nice if the app runs at lower priority); a large iowait band would point at disk instead of compute. X-axis: wall-clock time (local, linear).

targets.expr: instance:node_cpu_mode:ratio{mode="user"}
instance:node_cpu_mode:ratio{mode="nice"}
instance:node_cpu_mode:ratio{mode="system"}
instance:node_cpu_mode:ratio{mode="iowait"}

# AI prompt: "sum of the remaining non-idle CPU modes per instance, excluding user, nice, system and iowait"
sum by (instance) (instance:node_cpu_mode:ratio{mode!~"user|nice|system|iowait"})

panels.title: Load average · runnable tasks per CPU core
panels.description: Load average divided by the number of cores. Values above 1.0 mean more work is waiting than the CPU can run at once. X-axis: wall-clock time (local, linear).

targets.expr: instance:node_load1_per_cpu:ratio

# AI prompt: "5-minute load average divided by the number of CPUs per instance"
node_load5 / on (instance) instance:node_num_cpu:count

# AI prompt: "15-minute load average divided by the number of CPUs per instance"
node_load15 / on (instance) instance:node_num_cpu:count

panels.title: Memory breakdown · used, cache and free
panels.description: Stacked to total RAM. 'Used' is what applications hold; cache and buffers are reclaimable, so pressure only starts when 'free' and cache both shrink. X-axis: wall-clock time (local, linear).

targets.expr:
# AI prompt: "RAM used by applications: total minus available"
node_memory_MemTotal_bytes - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes

# AI prompt: "RAM used for page cache and buffers"
node_memory_Cached_bytes + node_memory_Buffers_bytes
node_memory_MemFree_bytes

panels.title: Disk free space · per filesystem
panels.description: Free space as a share of each real filesystem's size (tmpfs and FUSE mounts excluded). Green ≥ 15 %, amber 5–15 %, red below 5 %.

targets.expr: instance:node_filesystem_avail:ratio

panels.title: Disk throughput · read vs write
panels.description: Bytes per second read from and written to physical disks. Captioning should barely touch the disk once the model is loaded. X-axis: wall-clock time (local, linear).

targets.expr:
# AI prompt: "bytes read per second from physical disks, excluding loop, ram and device-mapper devices"
sum(rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total{device!~"loop.*|ram.*|dm-.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

# AI prompt: "bytes written per second to physical disks, excluding loop, ram and device-mapper devices"
sum(rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{device!~"loop.*|ram.*|dm-.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Network · receive vs transmit
panels.description: Bytes per second on physical interfaces (loopback, docker and tailscale excluded). Large ZIP uploads from remote clients appear as receive spikes. X-axis: wall-clock time (local, linear).

targets.expr: instance:node_network_receive_bytes:rate30s
instance:node_network_transmit_bytes:rate30s

panels.title: 6 · Model and inputs — what is the model producing and what are users sending?
Model parameters
panels.description: Parameters in the loaded default model.

targets.expr: caption_model_parameters{model="blip-base"}

panels.title: Model weights in RAM
panels.description: Bytes of parameters and buffers of the loaded default model.

targets.expr: caption_model_memory_bytes{model="blip-base"}

panels.title: Model load time
panels.description: Wall-clock time to load the default model at startup.

targets.expr: caption_model_load_seconds{model="blip-base"}

panels.title: Torch CPU threads
panels.description: Intra-op threads torch uses for inference.

targets.expr: caption_torch_threads

panels.title: Avg caption length
panels.description: Average words per caption in the selected range (Histogram _sum ÷ _count).

targets.expr:
# AI prompt: "average words per caption over the dashboard time range from the caption_length_words histogram sum and count"
sum(increase(caption_length_words_sum[$__range])) / sum(increase(caption_length_words_count[$__range]))

panels.title: Avg input resolution
panels.description: Average megapixels of uploaded images in the selected range, before downscaling.

targets.expr:
# AI prompt: "average image megapixels over the dashboard time range from the caption_image_megapixels histogram sum and count"
sum(increase(caption_image_megapixels_sum[$__range])) / sum(increase(caption_image_megapixels_count[$__range]))

panels.title: Decoder output · tokens generated per second, by model
panels.description: Caption tokens produced per second. Tracks throughput in model terms; beam width and max-token settings change it without changing images per second. X-axis: wall-clock time (local, linear).

targets.expr: job:caption_tokens:rate30s

panels.title: Upload volume · bytes received per second, by mode
panels.description: Upload bandwidth through the Streamlit widgets: one image (single) or a whole ZIP (bulk) arrives at once, so expect sharp spikes. X-axis: wall-clock time (local, linear).

targets.expr:
# AI prompt: "uploaded bytes per second by mode from caption_upload_bytes_total"
sum by (mode) (rate(caption_upload_bytes_total[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Skipped ZIP entries · by reason
panels.description: ZIP entries that were never sent to the model during the selected range, grouped by why they were skipped.

targets.expr:
# AI prompt: "number of skipped ZIP entries per reason during the dashboard time range, rounded to whole entries"
round(sum by (reason) (increase(caption_bulk_files_skipped_total[$__range])))

panels.title: Clients · requests by IP, session and browser
panels.description: Who used the app: request counts since the app started for every client seen in the selected range, from the client_ip, session_id and browser labels on caption_requests_total.

targets.expr:
# AI prompt: "latest request count per client IP, session, browser and mode for clients seen during the dashboard time range"
sum by (client_ip, session_id, browser, mode) (last_over_time(caption_requests_total[$__range]))

panels.title: Errors · by stage and type
panels.description: Errors during the selected range, e.g. decode / OSError for a truncated JPEG or unzip / BadZipFile for a corrupt archive.

targets.expr:
# AI prompt: "number of errors per stage and error type during the dashboard time range, rounded to whole errors"
round(sum by (stage, error_type) (increase(caption_errors_total[$__range])))
